name: Pure Energy Group Inc
old_description: Local Oregon installers helping homeowners and business owners lower their electric bills with solar.
about:
Pure Energy Group Inc is based in Jefferson, Oregon, and was founded in February 2021. The company began with a goal to bring affordable solar energy to Oregon homeowners and businesses while emphasizing integrity, community, and family values.

The firm provides residential, commercial, and agricultural solar installation services, along with battery backup systems and solar panel removal and reinstallation. With a team of about 40 employees, the company handles design, permitting, installation, and post‑installation support through an in‑house crew.

Its customers include homeowners across the Willamette Valley, businesses such as the Millersburg Fire Station, agricultural operations like Iseli Nursery, and community organizations including the Boys & Girls Club of Albany. The company has also contributed to Energy Trust of Oregon milestone projects.

Pure Energy Group says it differentiates itself through a local, in‑house team that manages every project from consultation to ongoing maintenance, transparent pricing, and a commitment to community involvement.

name: Pure Power Solar
old_description: is honored to be selected for these Solarize Campaigns. As NABCEP-certified solar professionals with a long-term record of satisfied customers, we are excited to serve our local communities while helping Louisville and Boyle County meet their ambitious clean energy goals. I’d like to thank the Kentucky Solar Energy Society (KYSES), the City of Louisville, and Boyle County for trusting us with their Solarize campaigns.
about:
Pure Power Solar is based in Louisville, Kentucky. Founded in 2017 by Nicholas Hartnett, a Louisville native and University of Kentucky alumnus who returned from a solar sales career in Southern California to start the company. He aimed to create an honest, reputable solar installer in a market he felt was plagued by deceptive tactics.

The company designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems and battery storage for residential and commercial customers. All work is performed by an in-house crew without subcontractors, covering design, permitting, grid interconnection, and monitoring setup. As of the latest count, the team has completed over 500 installations. They are authorized installers for Tesla, SolarEdge, and EG4 equipment.

Pure Power Solar serves homeowners, businesses, nonprofits, churches, and municipal governments in the Louisville area and surrounding Kentucky communities. The company has been selected for multiple Solarize campaigns, including Solarize Louisville (2024, 2025, 2026), Solarize Boyle (2025), and Solarize Frankfort (2023, 2024), reflecting its role in community-driven clean energy programs.

Hartnett founded the business to counter what he saw as deceptive sales practices and fly-by-night installers. The company emphasizes full control over every installation step, a no-subcontractor policy, and a commitment to ethical sales without high-pressure tactics. It maintains an A+ Better Business Bureau rating and five-star Google reviews across its project history.

name: Q T Corporation
old_description: Since 1994, we've provided tested and proven custom panel solutions for OEM clients, industrial automated controls and switchgear. Today, we've grown to serve companies across the globe.
about:
QT Corporation is based in Wilson, North Carolina, and has been building custom electrical panels since 1994. The company is led by President Jimmy Sauls, Application Engineer Tyson Sauls, and Sales Representative Mark Sauls.

The shop specializes in the design, fabrication, wiring, and installation of OEM panels, industrial automation control panels, and switchgear protection and control panels. All assemblies are built to UL 508A and NEC standards, and every unit undergoes 100 percent functional testing before shipment. The facility, expanded in 2005, supports both low- and high-volume runs and offers just-in-time delivery to customers within a 2.5-hour radius of Wilson.

QT Corporation serves original-equipment manufacturers, industrial automation integrators, and electrical switchgear builders across the United States and internationally. Project examples include substation protection and control panels, interposing relay panels, and custom industrial control panels that integrate directly into machinery or plant processes.

The company emphasizes its decades of combined engineering and wiring experience, a strategic ordering process that lowers material costs, and on-site warranty service to support panels after installation. Fixtures and jigs are designed for each job to reduce assembly time, and the team works to help clients “move power forward” with cost-effective, reliable panel solutions.

name: QBit Semiconductor LTD.
old_description: QBit was founded, with core R&D members originating from Qualcomm’s imaging‑processing engineering team.
about:
QBit Semiconductor LTD. was founded in 2016 in Littleton, Massachusetts, by a core R&D team that originated from Qualcomm's imaging-processing engineering group. The company operates as a fabless semiconductor designer focused on system-on-chip (SOC) solutions.

The company develops highly integrated SOCs that combine precision motion control, intelligent image processing, and energy-aware sensing management. Its product lines include the QB63xx series, which entered mass production in 2020 using TSMC's 28nm process and achieves a low-power mode of 65 mW, and the QB66xx series, also in mass production since 2023. A next-generation QB7xxx series featuring an ARM Cortex-A76 processor is under development. QBit maintains R&D subsidiaries in Boston (QBIT USA) and Tokyo (QBIT JP).

QBit's chips serve markets including multifunction printers, printers, medical devices, intelligent self-service systems, photo printers, point-of-sale terminals, kiosks, robotics, and drones. Strategic investors and partners include ARM, TSMC, Qualcomm, and Sony, the latter having awarded QBit its Green Partner certification.

The company emphasizes its three-core-technology integration as a differentiator, aiming to expand into ASIC design and secure chip development with features such as Synopsys TRNG integration and ML-DSA cryptographic validation. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

name: QQ's Wood
old_description: Immerse yourself in the beauty of bespoke woodcraft, right here in the heart of Honolulu, Hawaii. At QQ's Wood Shop, we blend the serene essence of the islands with unparalleled craftsmanship to bring you custom furniture and unique gifts.
about:
QQ's Wood operates from a workshop in Honolulu, Hawaii. The business began when QQ, an engineer by training, turned a woodworking hobby into a full-time pursuit as a bespoke wood artisan. No founding year is disclosed.

The shop produces custom furniture, display cases, cutting boards, coasters, bowls, pens, gift boxes, and carved urns, all handcrafted using Hawaiian Koa, mahogany, and other sustainably sourced hardwoods. Processes include hand turning, hand carving, custom design, and food-safe finishing. The workshop also restores antique furniture and family heirlooms. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Clients range from individuals seeking one-of-a-kind furniture or gifts to families entrusting heirloom restoration. The company serves residential and gift markets, with projects including custom-fit furniture for homes and offices, commemorative urns, and personalized gift boxes.

QQ emphasizes a blend of technical precision and artistic flair drawn from an engineering background, and a collaborative approach that translates client visions into tangible pieces. The founder cites dedication to quality and passion for the craft as driving forces.

name: Quality Automotive Accessories
old_description: The Best Made-in-USA Automotive Accessories & Trim Since 1978
about:
Quality Automotive Accessories operates from Westford, Massachusetts, where it has been producing automotive trim and accessories since 1978. The company was established to supply the aftermarket with domestically made chrome and stainless steel components.

The product line centers on exterior accents such as door handle covers, mirror covers, rocker panels, pillar posts, gas cap door trim, and license plate bezels, all fabricated from 304 stainless steel or chrome-plated ABS plastic. QAA also developed the TARGA GARD series and offers custom part production for specific vehicle applications.

Its primary customers are automotive retailers and dealers across the specialty equipment market, a relationship reinforced by a long-standing SEMA partnership. The catalog covers late-model trucks and SUVs from Ford, Chevrolet, Ram, GMC, Cadillac, Toyota, and Honda.

The company emphasizes its Made-in-USA origin, fast shipping, and a breadth of inventory that it describes as the largest selection in the segment, positioning itself as a single source for both stocked and custom stainless steel trim.

name: Quality Bus And Truck Parts
old_description: Welcome to Quality Bus & Truck Parts — your trusted source for reliable, affordable used parts for school buses and medium-duty trucks. Whether you’re looking for body, chassis, or engine components, we are committed to helping you easily find the right part. Backed by expert service and fast shipping, we’re here to get you back on the road—quickly and reliably.
about:
Quality Bus & Truck Parts operates from Big Lake, Minnesota, and was founded in 2018. The business grew out of a recognition that school districts, fleet operators, and mechanics needed a dependable source for older, hard‑to‑find, and obsolete bus and truck components. After years of selling new parts through its sister company, Midwest Bus Parts, the founders identified a gap in the market for cost‑effective, high‑quality recycled parts and launched this venture to fill it.

The company specializes in sourcing, salvaging, and refurbishing used and remanufactured parts for school buses and medium‑duty trucks. Its inventory spans thousands of items across categories such as engine components, electrical systems, drivetrain assemblies, braking, HVAC, and body parts. Operations include nationwide distribution with international shipping capabilities, a parts lookup service, and a physical facility that also provides expert maintenance, inspections, and service work. Additionally, the firm runs a vehicle recycling program and purchases used school buses and medium‑duty trucks for teardown.

Customers range from individual bus owners to large municipal fleets. The company explicitly serves school districts, transportation contractors, fleet maintenance facilities, municipal fleets, commercial businesses, independent repair shops, bus owners and builders, and individual customers. Supported brands include Blue Bird, IC Bus, Thomas Built Buses, International, GMC, Freightliner, and Ford, with common engine platforms such as International DT466, MaxxForce series, Cummins 5.9 and ISB6.7, CAT C7 and 3126, Mercedes MBE series, Detroit Diesel, Ford Power Stroke, and Chevy Duramax.

Quality Bus & Truck Parts positions itself as more than a salvage yard, emphasizing reliable solutions over simple used‑part sales. Its stated differentiators are a deep inventory of hard‑to‑find components, cost‑effective remanufactured alternatives, industry‑specific expertise, and fast shipping. The mission is framed as "Honoring God by serving and growing our team, customers and suppliers," backed by core values that include a can‑do attitude, problem solving, sacrifice for others, honesty, and continuous growth.

name: Quality Cable Source
old_description: Your #1 source for cable, components, and custom cable assemblies.
about:
Quality Cable Source operates from East Dundee, Illinois. The company traces its roots to a combined 50 years of industry experience among its founders, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status have not been stated.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and ribbon cables for a range of applications. Its capabilities include military-grade OP camera cable assemblies, SEE9 cable sub-assemblies for electronic military applications, Delphi Metri-Pack 280 cable assemblies, and wire harnesses used in diesel engines. Production spans both prototype and bulk manufacturing of flat and ribbon cable assemblies, with an emphasis on rapid turnaround.

Quality Cable Source serves the electronics, telecommunications, military, and automotive sectors. Customers include manufacturers of electronic equipment requiring custom ribbon cables, telecommunications firms needing wire harness fabrication, defense contractors sourcing military-grade cable assemblies, and diesel engine builders using custom wire harnesses.

According to the company, its business philosophy centers on quality, integrity, and service. It differentiates itself through a commitment to adapting to customers’ changing requirements, maintaining on-time delivery, and achieving cost effectiveness through improved efficiency and technology.

name: Quality Food Company
old_description: Southern New England's Leading Wholesale Restaurant Distributor and Food Service Supplier
about:
Quality Food Company operates from West Warwick, Rhode Island, where it has served as a family-owned wholesale restaurant and food supply business since its founding in 1931. The company began as a local distributor and grew into one of the largest wholesale restaurant distributors in the state.

The company distributes a broad range of food and non-food products organized into categories including proteins, portion-controlled items, paper goods, produce, seafood, and janitorial supplies. It maintains a custom cutting room for fresh beef, pork, poultry, and veal, and runs daily delivery routes covering all of Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and southeastern Connecticut. A cash-and-carry operation at its facility provides same-day pickup for smaller orders.

Customers include independent restaurants, markets, delis, institutions, and commissaries throughout southern New England. The distributor has built a significant portion of its business around specialty cuisine markets, supplying ingredients for Italian, Asian, Brazilian, Portuguese, pub-and-tavern, and breakfast concepts, as well as serving Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian, and Asian community establishments.

Quality Food Company emphasizes its custom cutting room and daily fresh deliveries as core differentiators, along with a commitment to smaller family-owned operators that larger broadline distributors may overlook. Free delivery on orders above $1,500–$2,000 and a product assortment tailored to ethnic and regional menus round out its value proposition.

old_description: Restaurant Equipment & Supplies • Exhaust Hood System Experts • Custom SS Fabrication • AutoCAD Layout & Design • Free Consultation
about:
Quality Food Equipment has operated from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma since 1984. The company was founded by the McWhorter family and remains family-owned, now in its second and third generation of McWhorter leadership. The business began as a supplier of restaurant equipment and supplies, emphasizing personal service and quality products for the local community.

The company distributes a broad range of restaurant equipment and supplies across categories that include cooking equipment, refrigeration, dishwashing, ice machines, beverage and bar, food preparation, and smallwares. In addition to stocked inventory, Quality Food Equipment provides custom stainless steel fabrication, exhaust hood system design and installation, and AutoCAD-based kitchen layout and design services, complemented by free consultations.

The firm serves food-service operators throughout the Oklahoma City area, including restaurants, bars, concession stands, and commercial kitchens. Its team lives and works locally, and the company highlights its deep roots in the OKC community as a differentiator.

Quality Food Equipment positions itself on its family-owned heritage, local presence, and large in-stock inventory that allows quick fulfillment. The combination of distribution, custom fabrication, and design services under one roof is presented as a way to save customers money and keep their operations running smoothly.
